title: scry
description:
This repository is research on how models are trained and how they think. It asks whether changing the language a model learns in, or giving it a denser one, changes how well it reasons.

Results are to be measured with reasoning benchmarks at equal compute.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
